get.description: Lists BIM Model Revision Plans associated with the specified Project.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description:
The compact view contains only ids.
The extended view contains the response shown below.
The normal view contains 'bim_plan_id' and 'bim_level_id' instead of objects.
The default view is normal.

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[bim_plan_id]
parameters.description: Filter item(s) with matching BIM Plan ids

parameters.name: filters[bim_model_revision_id]
parameters.description: Filter item(s) with matching Bim Model Revision ids.

parameters.name: filters[bim_level_id]
parameters.description: Filter item(s) with matching BIM Level ids

200.description: BIM Model Revision Plans listed successfully

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

allOf.description: BIM Model Revision Plan associates BIM Plans to published BIM Model Revisions

bim_model_revision_id.description: ID of associated published BIM Model Revision

bim_level_id.description: ID of the Bim Level linked to the plan

oneOf.description: BIM Model Revision Plan associates BIM Plans to published BIM Model Revisions

bim_model_revision_id.description: ID of associated published BIM Model Revision

allOf.description: BIM Plan captures the plan view of a level and contains the plan as a drawing or an attached 2D sheet

bim_level_id.description: ID of the BIM Level that the plan is associated to

drawing_id.description: ID of the Drawing that the plan is associated to

title.description: Title of the plan. This reflects the title of the drawing associated to the plan. If plan is not associated to a drawing, the title will contain the associated location name

name.description: Base name of the file without its path

content_type.description: A mime type or a file extension

url.description: URL to download the attached file. HTTP client should be prepared to follow redirects to successfully download the file.

bim_file_id.description: ID of the BIM Model revision linked to the Level

location_id.description: ID of location linked to the Level

created_by_id.description: ID of user that created the level

403.description: User does not have permission to view BIM Model Revision Plans

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.
A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/bim_model_revision_plans?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&view=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bid%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bbim_plan_id%5D=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&filters%5Bbim_model_revision_id%5D=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&filters%5Bbim_level_id%5D=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"project_id\":126,\"bim_model_revision_plan\":{\"bim_model_revision_id\":16,\"bim_plan_id\":96}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/bim_model_revision_plans", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
